ShortDescription.Value: Show/Hide notification icons, add/remove Money, set Milestones, Mini HUD, Better Tooltips.

Publish.LongDescription:
#### City Watchdog organizes notification clutter, customizes city start options (e.g. milestones), and puts control of road names/arrows/districts/tooltips in your hands.
- visual comfort controls. you'll wonder how you've been playing without it :) - don't forget the Like button, top right, so search works and more people know about the mod.
#### Display toggles - [i] button - Instant hide/show **ALL** vanilla mouse-over tooltips. - 1-click - show/hide 1-way road arrows. - 1-click - hide/show road name or district.
#### Features - **Mini HUD**: custom tracker list for any problem; repeat clicking the icon will cycle and jump to all map spots. - **Notifications**: **Instant on/off** toggle for all problem alert icons (icons over buildings or cars). - Reduce visual stress while building (does not fix city problems for you). - Open full panel from the top-left button.
#### City Start Options - Start city with any Milestone. Trains now! Set Initial money if you want Less for a challenge or more. - Quick handy info: hover over bottom menu money or population tooltips for instant info chart (faster than opening game's Info view). - Convert saves from Unlimited Money type to normal Limited Money.
**Hotkeys** - Shift+N = open/close panel (same as clicking on Top Left icon). - N = show/hide problem alert icons (same as clicking Show/Hide Icons button). - [ = Add Money, hold to repeat. - ] = Subtract Money, hold to repeat.
### Important Notes - Unlimited Money save: make a backup before converting the save. Mod cannot undo that conversion. Check mod's "show instructions". - Install Achievement Fixer mod if you want Achievements while using mods (was removed from this mod). - Good for performance: lightweight for daily use.
I hope you enjoy the new features!
### Support and feedback - Feedback is welcome through GitHub or Discord link buttons on the right. - please give a Like so it's easier for people to find the mod. Thank you! no donations needed, just a Like is enough. - 15 languages: Hello, Hallo, Hola, Bonjour, Ciao, こんにちは, 안녕하세요, Cześć, Olá, Olá, สวัสดี, Merhaba, Xin chào, 你好, 你好 - If anyone can make better thumbnail or screenshots, please let me know. - Mod is safe for city saves and safe to remove. Does not use Harmony patch, safer/more compatible.
### New Bigger Scale button - Stays on until you click it off, even if CWD is removed, because it uses the game's real interface setting. - To reset the interface scale to normal, simply turn this button/toggle off before uninstalling the mod. - Or start the game once with --developerMode, then go to Options > Interface and turn off Interface Scaling (dev) checkbox.
### Thanks to all supporters and testers - River Mochi - main author - yenyang - locale tech feedback - Notices inspired by the orig. City Controller by Mbyron26. - Money View inspired by earlier Show Text by DanielNZ. - Dorkington - tester/feature suggestion - Brainium, Flightech, SonNathan - testers - UnMaestro - testing, German editor - gagaxm - testing, French editor - Obelix - testing, Portuguese editor - Thumbnail photograph by Maryia Shedava at Mont Saint-Michel in Normandy, France: https://unsplash.com/photos/a-dog-poses-in-front-of-a-distant-castle-bEpjaU_CTcM

Publish.ChangeLog: - Accessibility: Bigger UI scale button, instant on/off. Uses the game's Interface Scaling option from developer mode - now available in normal mode from the CWD title bar or mod Options. - synced with the same [x] checkbox in Options and the game's vanilla Interface Scaling (dev) ☑ checkbox. - New notification Presets [1 | 2] for saving sets of ☑ checkboxes (hold "1" or "2" down for 1 second to save whatever you currently checked ☑). - you now have 4 choices for Notification Icons: all problem icons On/Off or Preset 1 or 2 (for more custom action). - Notification row is now clickable to jump to issues, not just the count number. - Main panel Rows with active alerts stay bright white even when their icons are hidden with Hide Icons. - Renamed: City Start tab replaces Milestone tab name. - Fixed: Toolbar right-aligned. Show Icons button hover keeps its color. - Show/Hide Icons label no longer spills over in long languages (DE/ES/FR shortened). - new Defaults: main panel opacity 80%; Mini starts horizontal; Money View trends = Monthly.
